app.name: Combo Lab
app.tagline: Decks, combos and practice for Yu-Gi-Oh!

home.title: Home
home.lead: Start from an archetype, write the list, then turn your lines of play into combos you can rehearse.
home.emptyBody: When you create your first deck or import a .ydk file, it shows up here with your latest changes.

archetypes.title: Archetypes
archetypes.emptyBody: An archetype gathers the variants and lists of one strategy. Create the first one to get going.
archetypes.lead: Each archetype keeps its list variants, key cards and game plan together.
archetypes.noResultsBody: Try another name or remove some filters.
archetypes.noTags: No tags yet: type one below.

dialog.createBody: Name the strategy. You can add key cards, notes and variants afterwards.
dialog.nameHint: One language is enough: the other is optional.

archetypes.notesPlaceholder: How it plays: ideal opening, hand traps to fear, weak spots…
archetypes.notesHint: Notes save when you leave the field. Each language has its own text.

roles.keyCardsHint: The cards that define the strategy.
roles.startersHint: Cards that start the combo on their own.
roles.empty: No cards in this list yet. Add one with search.

picker.body: Tap a card to add or remove it. Search by name in Italian or English.
picker.idle: Type a card name to start.

archetypes.noVariantsBody: A variant is a full list (Main, Extra, Side) with its own rules and banlist. Create one or import a deck.
archetypes.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted or not synced to this device yet.

decks.title: Decks
decks.emptyBody: Build a list from scratch, or import a .ydk file, a ydke code or copied text.
decks.lead: All your variants, grouped by archetype. Import a list from a file, text or link.
decks.importBody: Paste, drop a file or pick one.

variantDialog.createBody: Pick the rules and banlist used to check legality.
variantDialog.banlistHint: Legality updates right away when you change it.

combos.title: Combos
combos.emptyBody: Record the steps of a line of play: the cards you need, the moves and the final board.

learn.title: Learn
learn.emptyBody: Once you save a combo you can practise it step by step, even offline.

stats.title: Stats
stats.emptyBody: With a saved deck you can work out the odds of opening the right cards and see how the list is built.

language.title: Language
language.description: Change the interface language. Card names follow the chosen language when available.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose how the app looks. System follows your device settings.

about.title: About
about.body: Combo Lab works without a connection. Your data stays on this device until you turn on sync.

palette.title: Commands
palette.description: Search for a section or a command.
palette.hint: Search a card by name (IT or EN) or jump to a section.

main.title: Main is empty
main.body: Search for a card and tap it to add it. You need 40 to 60 cards.

extra.title: Extra is empty
extra.body: Fusion, Synchro, Xyz and Link cards go here automatically (up to 15).

side.title: Side is empty
side.body: Double-tap a card in the results, or use the Side button, to add it here (up to 15).

search.label: Search cards
search.hint: One tap adds to Main or Extra. Two taps add to Side.
search.idleBody: Type a name, typos are fine: “ash blossom” and “fioritura di cenere” find the same card.
search.noResultsBody: Check the name or change the type and attribute filters.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.emptyBody: Add a few cards and types, levels and attributes show up here.

deck.importBody: The imported list replaces the current one. You can undo right after.

dataError.title: Card data unavailable
dataError.body: I can't load the card list ({{message}}). Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Variant not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted or not synced to this device yet.

legality.legalBody: It follows {{rules}} rules and the {{banlist}} banlist.
legality.illegalBody: Checked against {{rules}} rules and the {{banlist}} banlist. Cards with problems are highlighted.
legality.banlistMissing: The {{banlist}} banlist isn't in the data: no copy limits are applied.

issue.forbidden: {{name}} is Forbidden: you can't include it (you have {{count}}).
issue.limited: {{name}} is Limited: 1 copy at most, you have {{count}}.
issue.semi-limited: {{name}} is Semi-Limited: 2 copies at most, you have {{count}}.
issue.too-many-copies: {{name}}: 3 copies at most across the whole deck, you have {{count}}.
issue.main-size: Main has {{count}} cards: it needs {{min}} to {{max}}.
issue.extraInMain: {{name}} is an Extra Deck card: it can't go in the Main.
issue.extra-size: Extra has {{count}} cards: the maximum is {{max}}.
issue.nonExtraInExtra: {{name}} isn't an Extra Deck card: it can't go in the Extra.
issue.side-size: Side has {{count}} cards: the maximum is {{max}}.
issue.genesys-points: Genesys points: {{points}} out of a maximum of {{cap}}.
issue.unknown-card: Card code {{id}} not recognized: update the data or remove it.

banlistNotice.body: These variants still use an older banlist. Under {{banlist}} they would no longer be legal.

import.title: Import a deck
import.lead: Paste here: I detect the format on my own.
import.placeholder: Paste a list (IT or EN), a ydke:// link, the contents of a .ydk file or a Combo Lab JSON
import.formats: You can also drop a .ydk file onto this box. Formats: .ydk, ydke://, text with Italian or English names, Combo Lab JSON.
import.fuzzyDone_one: {{count}} line fixed for a small typo
import.shareEmpty: I found nothing to import in the shared content.

error.empty: There's nothing to import: paste a list or choose a file.
error.invalid: The content looks like a deck format but isn't valid. Check that you copied all of it.
error.needsIndex: Loading card data: I'll retry on my own as soon as it's ready.
error.noCards: I didn't recognize any card. Check the names or the format.
error.tooBig: The file is too large (2 MB maximum).

review.title: Review the import
review.body: {{matched}} lines recognized, {{ambiguous}} to clarify, {{unmatched}} not found.
review.ambiguousHint: Several cards share this name: pick the right one.
review.unmatchedHint: These lines are skipped. Fix them and import again if you need them.
review.resolved: Choices made: {{done}} of {{total}}. Lines without a choice are skipped.

export.title: Export the deck
export.lead: Copy with one tap or download the file.
export.textHint: Readable list with names in the app language.
export.ydkeHint: Paste it into EDOPro, Master Duel Meta and similar.
export.jsonHint: Re-import it here without losing anything.
export.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the text and copy it by hand.
